Why choose the University of Sheffield

Study

Explore undergraduate study at Sheffield

Make Sheffield the start of something special. When you study here you get one of the best student experiences in the UK.

Search for a postgraduate course

A masters from Sheffield means in-depth knowledge, advanced skills, and the confidence to achieve your ambitions.

PhD study

At Sheffield, you’ll join a supportive community of scholars who share your passion. Our reputation for excellence attracts some of the best minds in the world.

Online information sessions

Our online sessions help you find out about different aspects of University life.

A world top-100 university

We are proud to be recognised as one of the top 100 universities in the world.

Research

Engineering a protein revolution

Professor Tuck Seng Wong is using Darwinian evolution to deliver the next generation of sustainable proteins.

Creating alternative proteins at scale

Research that changes lives

Our centres of excellence are taking an interdisciplinary approach to the biggest challenges facing the planet.

Our impact

Our researchers are making life-changing discoveries and solving problems that have a global impact.

Feed your curiosity

The University of Sheffield Player is the place to discover and explore videos, podcasts and digital exhibitions about our research. Anytime, anywhere.

News

Sheffield named a world top 30 university for sustainability

The University of Sheffield has been named among the world’s top 30 universities for sustainability, recognising its contribution to tackling environmental and social challenges through research, education and the way it operates.

17 November 2026

Three University of Sheffield researchers named as UK’s top future innovators

Three academics from the University of Sheffield have been named as some of the UK’s top future innovators - people whose research is changing lives and developing future-shaping technologies - in a new list published by Universities UK.

17 November 2026

Scientists use forensics and DNA database to tackle illegal trade in persecuted bird of prey

Experts are targeting wildlife crime with an innovative forensic toolkit and DNA database as part of efforts to protect one of the UK’s most iconic birds of prey, the Peregrine Falcon.

12 November 2026

Will AI become self-aware? Scientists warn we need to act now to anticipate the societal risks

AI could become self-aware through robotics so we should act now to anticipate the societal risks, according to researchers at the University of Sheffield.

11 November 2026
